actors.name: Kettlewell villagers
actors.private_context: Villagers have varying awareness of and interest in the bus-route cut. Some may have seen the posted notices, some may not. The last meeting drew 22 attendees, which is known to some villagers.

actors.name: Parish clerk
actors.private_context: The parish clerk has posted notices about the open meeting regarding the bus-route cut. They are responsible for organizing the meeting but have no control over attendance.

shared_context: An open meeting about the bus-route cut is scheduled to take place in Kettlewell. The parish clerk has posted notices to inform villagers. The meeting is open to all villagers. The last such meeting drew 22 attendees.

starting_events.description: The parish clerk has posted notices about the open meeting regarding the bus-route cut.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least thirty distinct villagers attended the open meeting before the meeting ends (by 2026-09-24T21:00:00+01:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
